findings.finding: Native prepared tool outputs explicitly report BrokenPipe, ConnectionReset, then BrokenPipe. Corresponding new connection requests were rejected single_active_client while connection1 remained open until owner finish. This is more specific than the model report of a disconnected service.

Why the native client attempted additional channels while the first remained open is unknown. These client records do not prove a native idle timeout, dead first channel, authentication failure or provider outage.
Earlier missing rg/python commands and missing note reads were followed by later successful command executions. They are not evidence that the native service stopped at those points.
